statement: Each QS graph admits generic positive real edge lengths for which all its 2^(n−2) planar realization classes are real.
scope: QS is the recursively defined subclass in result R_fe9dc09adc4b3475f458ffc4d50d04aca67d21d5dd8ed88ca2982da0e852da99. n≥3; reflected realizations are distinct.
notes: The source identifies reflections and counts 2^(n−3); generic noncollinearity doubles this under the catalogue convention.
